description: PHP class defining the Candidate entity for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, including properties for candidate details, relationships, and ORM mapping annotations.

classes.name: Candidate
classes.description: Represents a job candidate with personal details, application info, and related entities in the OrangeHRM recruitment module.

methods.name: getMiddleName
methods.description: Returns the candidate's middle name, if any.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns additional comment about the candidate.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets additional comment about the candidate.

methods.name: getModeOfApplication
methods.description: Returns the mode of application (manual or online).

methods.name: getDateOfApplication
methods.description: Returns the date when the application was made.

methods.name: getCvFileId
methods.description: Returns ID of the associated CV file (deprecated).

methods.name: setCvFileId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the associated CV file (deprecated).

methods.name: getAddedPerson
methods.description: Returns the employee who added this candidate.

methods.name: setAddedPerson
methods.description: Sets the employee who added this candidate.

methods.name: isConsentToKeepData
methods.description: Checks if candidate has given consent to keep data.

methods.name: setConsentToKeepData
methods.description: Sets consent status for data retention.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Returns the collection of candidate's vacancy applications.

methods.name: getCandidateHistory
methods.description: Returns the candidate's history of actions.
